name: device-lost-busy-cpu
about: device-lost-building on a busy machine: one thread a logical processor busy at the normal priority for the whole run (GALAXY_TEST_CPU_LOAD). Each restore stops the pipeline workers, which run at the lowest priority: they finish their jobs raised to the normal priority, so the stop takes under a second (N-1072: 4.9 to 7.4 s here before, 16.7 s in a gate, the workers starved).
